text: なんだよ　また　きたのかよ　まさか　おまえ…　サカキとか　いう　やつの　こども　なんじゃ　ないのか？

structure.jp: サカキとか　いう　やつの　こども　なんじゃ　ないのか？
structure.en: aren't you the kid of that Giovanni guy or whatever?

patterns.name: 〜とかいう
patterns.explanation: とかいう after a name means 'called something like', showing the speaker is unsure of the name or does not care. サカキとか　いう　やつ = 'that guy called Giovanni or whatever'.

patterns.name: 〜のではないか
patterns.span: なんじゃ　ないのか
patterns.explanation: んじゃないのか is the casual spoken form of のではないか. It voices a suspicion: 'isn't it the case that...?'. こども　なんじゃ　ないのか = 'aren't you the kid?'.

patterns.name: 〜のか
patterns.explanation: のか at the end asks for confirmation of something the speaker has just noticed, in a rough tone. きたのか = 'so you came?'.
